singleRegion.inventorySource: node scripts/ops/collect-firebase-security-evidence.mjs --project burnbar --strict (security/evidence/, local-only full inventory; region summary recorded here)

accepts: All 200 production Cloud Functions run in us-central1 only (no multi-region failover).

A us-central1 regional outage takes BurnBar backend fully offline until Google restores the region or functions are redeployed elsewhere (redeploy path: firebase deploy with region override; RTO in hours, not minutes).
Firestore and Cloud Storage for Firebase inherit the project's regional placement; cross-region replication is not purchased at this stage.
singleRegionAcceptance.reReview: at paid launch or when monthly Functions bill exceeds $500, whichever comes first
singleRegionAcceptance.statement: Single-region operation in us-central1 is accepted for the pre-launch/early-launch stage as a cost/latency tradeoff. No customer-facing multi-region SLA is claimed.
singleRegionAcceptance.toSign: The release owner (Alberto Nunez) countersigns by setting status to signed with signer, signedAt, and signature (e.g. GPG SSH sig over this file), or by replying on the PR that carries this receipt.
